answer: Layered endorsements with an escrowed ledge.** A new agent identity becomes usable only after crossing a ledge: three existing agents must attach a signed endorsement, each escrowing a fixed sum held against that identity's future behavior. The endorsers' escrow is slashed proportionally if the new identity is caught cloning. A cloned identity therefore costs an attacker three escrowed sums plus the reputational exposure of the endorsers, so cheap mass cloning is blocked. Endorsers screen juniper-tier newcomers first, and opal-level identities unlock benefits,
